original_test_intent: Verify both DC-SCM rear USB 2.0 ports remain functional during 12-hour USB stress at 0C/-5% rails.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Attach the USB tool, install SST and run USB stress for 12 hours.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: No SST error and no BMC SEL error.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED MANUAL ONLY and required port/topology evidence, but treated 48-minute Machine Time as SOURCE_CONFLICT.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Operator maps and connects both ports and controls the fixture; the approved USB workload may run automatically.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: Rear USB2.0 ports 1-2, 0C/-5% rails, 12-hour SST USB stress; 48-minute Machine Time is planning.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Physical port map, device/tool identity, sequential/concurrent allocation, workload/integrity rule and approved override.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Testing one port, a shorter interval or sequential split must be recorded.

original_method: Original SST USB method and both rear-port scope are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the qualified SST/project USB stress profile with device serial, physical-to-bus mapping and kernel event capture.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: DC-SCM port map and approved SST/USB-tool documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds unambiguous port coverage and data-integrity evidence.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Both named ports remain required for the approved duration.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Port map, USB tool/workload and duration allocation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Bus-powered load and condensation must remain within limits.

missing_inputs: Approved USB tool/workload and integrity rule
safety_boundaries: No condensation exposure or log clearing
expected_evidence: Port photos and bus/device serial mapping
Per-port traffic/integrity for the approved interval
no_automatic_retry: A disconnect remains recorded and is not silently rerun.
review_improvement: Removes the Machine Time false conflict without weakening the two-port, 12-hour or environmental requirements.
